design_philosophy: Authority-first, low-friction conversion. Tone is experienced operator, not marketer. No SaaS fluff. Short headlines, bold phrases, generous spacing.

buttons.primary: bg-gold text-navy font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm px-8 py-4 hover:bg-gold/90 transition-colors inline-flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: border border-white/30 text-white font-mono font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sm px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors inline-flex items-center justify-center

cards.service_card: p-8 border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors group

1_Hero.content: Centered or left-aligned. JetBrains Mono overline, large Playfair Display headline, short subheadline. Two CTAs.

2_Trust_Strip.content: Single-line text in JetBrains Mono scrolling or spaced evenly. 'AUTHORITY-FIRST // LOW-FRICTION CONVERSION // EXPERIENCED OPERATORS'

3_Field_Reality.content: Headline 'What We Actually See on the Floor'. 4 items in a clean grid with high-quality stock photos.

4_Human_Layer.content: Alternate light section. Split 2 columns: Vince photo (left) + Video placeholder (right). Tight text explaining operator experience.

5_Why_Private_vs_OSHA.content: Comparison points using thin dividers and generous spacing. Bold key phrases, short descriptions.

6_What_We_Do.content: 3 services in thin-bordered cards or rows. One-line each: Safety Walkthroughs, Documentation Reviews, Incident Response.

7_What_You_Get.content: List of 5 deliverables. JetBrains Mono numbering. Callout box at end: 'This is not a full audit. It is a signal.'

8_Who_We_Work_With.content: 4 operation types (Manufacturers, Warehouses, Contractors, Fleets) in a minimal grid.

9_Testimonial.content: Single powerful quote. Large serif font, gold quotation marks.

11_Final_CTA.content: Dual button setup. Direct, operator tone.

testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links) must include `data-testid` attribute.
